cause_reproduced.failure: Friend notification processing errors were swallowed; the page still committed its checkpoint. Existing local friend rows were reused, and roster-version-only recovery could not repair a profile absent from the incremental response.
cause_reproduced.old_code_repro: Isolated original notification dispatcher failed regression: err=nil and checkpoint advanced 1 -> 2 after temporary friend storage failure.
cause_reproduced.fixed_code: Failure retains checkpoint 1; retry of the same notification commits 2 after recovery.

changes: Propagate friend notification failure before checkpoint persistence.
Refresh server-designated existing friend profiles on profile events independently of roster version and bulk cooldown.
Repair existing profiles in the auxiliary recovery job in batches <=100; cooldown one minute only after complete success; preserve offline data and retry failed passes.
Use existing commit, cache eviction and friendship callbacks; reject partial/duplicate/foreign responses; never re-add a deleted friend or copy group aliases.
Evict public user cache after full friend table replacement.
Flutter profile applies avatar changes and fences older identity reads.
